### Outfit 2: Edgy Vintage Contrast

Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print** and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottom:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (w_001)
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket (w_006)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (w_007)
* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag (w_010)

**Why this works:** 
This look leans directly into the 2000s aesthetic of the baby tee. The fitted, cropped silhouette of the butterfly top creates a balanced proportion when paired with the baggy, high-waisted dark wash jeans. Layering the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket adds texture without hiding the waistline, while the chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag tie the streetwear theme together.

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print** and pieces from the saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Y2K Streetwear Contrast
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** This look leans directly into the Y2K aesthetic of the baby tee by pairing its fitted, cropped silhouette with high-waisted, baggy dark-wash jeans for a classic early-2000s proportion play (fitted top, loose bottoms). Layering the slightly cropped black denim jacket and finishing with chunky white sneakers ties the streetwear elements together while keeping the color palette grounded in classic denim and black-and-white.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Earth-Tone Mix
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt (`w_009`) & Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)

**Why it works:** The butterfly print baby tee features soft pink, purple, and white tones that pop against the neutral khaki of the wide-leg trousers. Adding the brown leather belt introduces a warm, classic accent that complements the tan trousers, while the chunky white sneakers echo the white base of the baby tee for a balanced, effortless everyday look.

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the new Y2K Baby Tee with Butterfly Print and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print (New Item)
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
* **Accessory:** Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
This look leans directly into the Y2K aesthetic of the baby tee. The fitted, cropped silhouette of the butterfly top creates a balanced proportion when paired with the voluminous, high-waisted baggy dark-wash jeans. Layering the slightly cropped black denim jacket on top adds a cool, cohesive texture, while the chunky white sneakers and minimal crossbody bag tie the retro streetwear vibe together.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Contrast with Earth Tones
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print (New Item)
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
* **Accessory:** Brown leather belt (`w_009`)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)

**Why it works:**
This combination plays on the mix of styles by pairing the sweet, graphic-heavy Y2K top with the neutral, tailored feel of wide-leg khaki trousers. Tucking in the baby tee and adding the brown leather belt defines the waist and bridges the color palette between the pinks/purples of the tee and the tan bottoms. Finished with chunky white sneakers, it's an effortless, everyday outfit with a subtle nod to vintage style.
```

Here are two outfit ideas featuring the light wash, cropped denim jacket from Wrangler:

### Outfit 2: Effortless Monochromatic Denim

* **Suggested Piece to Pair:** White or cream ribbed knit midi dress

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the new Y2K Baby Tee with Butterfly Print and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **New Item:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:** 
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why they work together:** 
This look leans directly into early 2000s proportions. The fitted, cropped silhouette of the baby tee balances out the volume of the high-waisted, baggy dark-wash jeans. Finishing the outfit with chunky white sneakers and a minimal black crossbody bag keeps the streetwear aesthetic cohesive and effortless.

---

### Outfit 2: Edgy Contrast Look
* **New Item:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:** 
  * Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
  * Black combat boots (`w_008`)

**Why they work together:** 
The baby tee brings a touch of soft, playful color (white, pink, and purple) and a butterfly graphic, which contrasts nicely with the tougher, grunge elements like the black combat boots and vintage black denim jacket. Pairing these with wide-leg khaki trousers adds an unexpected earth-tone neutral base that grounds the pastel tones of the top.
```

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfit suggestions incorporating the new Y2K baby tee with pieces from your wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print (New Item)
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (w_001)
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket (w_006)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (w_007)
* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag (w_010)

**Why it works:** 
This look leans directly into the 2000s aesthetic of the baby tee. Pairing the fitted, cropped graphic top with high-waisted, baggy straight-leg jeans creates a classic Y2K proportion play—snug on top and loose on the bottom. The slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket adds an extra layer of texture without hiding the waistline, while the chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag tie the streetwear theme together effortlessly.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Contrast
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print (New Item)
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers (w_002)
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt (w_009), Black crossbody bag (w_010)
* **Shoes:** Black combat boots (w_008)

**Why it works:**
This outfit plays with a mix of styles by combining the sweet, pink-and-purple butterfly graphic of the baby tee with the earthy, minimalist structure of the wide-leg khaki trousers. Tucking in the baby tee and accentuating the waist with the brown leather belt grounds the look, while the black combat boots add a bit of edge to balance out the softer pastel tones of the top.
```

Here are two outfit ideas featuring the new Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print paired with items from your wardrobe:

* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (w_001)

* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (w_007)

This look plays on classic early 2000s proportions by pairing the fitted, cropped silhouette of the baby tee with the relaxed, high-waisted fit of the dark wash baggy jeans. Throwing on the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket adds an extra layer of texture while keeping the silhouette balanced, and the chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag tie the casual, streetwear-inspired aesthetic together.

---

### Outfit 2: Contrast Grunge & Graphic
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers (w_002)
* **Shoes:** Black combat boots (w_008)
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt (w_009), Black crossbody bag (w_010)

Tucking the fitted tee into the wide-leg khaki trousers (cinched with the brown leather belt) creates a neat waistline, while the black combat boots add an unexpected, edgy anchor to the softer earth tones and pastel pink and purple accents.

```
Here are two outfit suggestions featuring the Y2K Baby Tee with Butterfly Print and pieces from the saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **New Item:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:**
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
  * Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
This look leans directly into the Y2K aesthetic of the baby tee. Pairing the cropped, fitted silhouette of the butterfly top with the high-waisted, baggy dark-wash jeans creates a balanced contrast in proportions. Layering the slightly cropped black denim jacket on top adds depth while keeping the silhouette short, and the chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag tie the casual, streetwear-inspired vibe together.

---

### Outfit 2: Contrast Grunge-Cottagecore
* **New Item:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:**
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
  * Black combat boots (`w_008`)
  * Brown leather belt (`w_009`)

**Why it works:**
This outfit plays on mixed aesthetics by combining the sweet, cottagecore-leaning butterfly graphic tee with tougher, utilitarian pieces. Tucking the baby tee into the wide-leg khaki trousers and defining the waist with the brown leather belt anchors the look. Finishing it with the black combat boots adds a touch of grunge edge, creating an effortless, unexpected mix of styles.
```

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print** and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (w_001)
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket (w_006)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (w_007)
* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag (w_010)

**Why it works:** 
This look leans directly into the 2000s aesthetic of the baby tee. Pairing the fitted, cropped butterfly top with the dark wash baggy straight-leg jeans creates a classic Y2K proportion play—tight on top and loose on the bottom. Tossing the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket on top adds an extra layer of texture, while the chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag tie the casual streetwear vibe together.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Earth-Tone Contrast
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers (w_002)
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt (w_009), Black crossbody bag (w_010)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers (w_007)

**Why it works:**
This outfit balances the playful, colorful graphics of the baby tee with the neutral, relaxed feel of the wide-leg khaki trousers. Tucking in the fitted crop top and adding the brown leather belt defines the waist against the high-volume trousers, creating an effortless mix of streetwear and minimal everyday style. Finished with chunky white sneakers, it's a comfortable and balanced daytime look.
```

Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print** and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why this works:** 
This look leans directly into the Y2K aesthetic of the baby tee. The fitted, cropped silhouette of the tee balances out the voluminous, high-waisted baggy jeans for a classic 2000s proportion play. The chunky white sneakers tie into the white base of the tee, while the black crossbody bag keeps the accessories simple and functional.

---

### Outfit 2: Edgy Contrast
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
* **Shoes:** Black combat boots (`w_008`)

**Why this works:**
This outfit creates a fun contrast by pairing the sweet, graphic-heavy baby tee and earthy khaki trousers with tougher, grunge-inspired elements like the black combat boots and vintage black denim jacket. The slightly cropped jacket mirrors the length of the baby tee, and the mix of khaki, pink, purple, and black gives the outfit an effortless, curated edge.

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print**:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **New Item:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (w_001)
  * Chunky white sneakers (w_007)
  * Black crossbody bag (w_010)

**Why it works:** 
This pairing leans right into the early 2000s aesthetic. The fitted, cropped silhouette of the baby tee balances the volume of the baggy, high-waisted dark wash jeans. Finishing the look with chunky white sneakers and a black crossbody bag keeps the outfit casual, cohesive, and effortlessly cool.

---

### Outfit 2: Edgy Contrast
* **New Item:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Wardrobe Pieces:**
  * Vintage black denim jacket (w_006)
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (w_002)
  * Black combat boots (w_008)

**Why it works:**
This look plays with a mix of styles by pairing the sweet, graphic butterfly baby tee and neutral wide-leg trousers with tougher pieces. The slightly cropped black denim jacket and lace-up combat boots add a grunge-inspired edge that contrasts nicely with the soft pinks and purples of the tee's print.
```

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfit ideas incorporating the 90s Track Jacket:

### Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear
* **New Item:** 90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:** 
  * White ribbed tank top
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
  * Chunky white sneakers
  * Black crossbody bag

**Why it works:** 
This look leans into the athletic, retro vibe of the track jacket. Layering the jacket open over the fitted white ribbed tank creates a balanced silhouette against the relaxed fit of the dark wash baggy straight-leg jeans. The chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag tie the sporty streetwear aesthetic together effortlessly.

---

### Outfit 2: Elevated Sport-Casual
* **New Item:** 90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:** 
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers
  * Brown leather belt
  * Chunky white sneakers

**Why it works:** 
Pairing the sporty track jacket with tailored wide-leg khaki trousers creates a stylish high-low mix of athletic and smart-casual elements. Tucking in the jacket (or wearing it zipped) paired with the brown leather belt adds structure to the outfit, while the chunky white sneakers keep the overall feel grounded and modern.
```

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe** and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear
* **New Item:** 90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * White ribbed tank top
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
  * Chunky white sneakers
  * Black crossbody bag

**Why it works:** 
This look leans into the retro athletic vibe of the track jacket. Layering the jacket open over the fitted white tank top creates a nice contrast in silhouettes against the relaxed, baggy straight-leg jeans. Finishing with chunky white sneakers ties the sporty aesthetic together, while the black crossbody bag adds a practical, everyday touch.

---

### Outfit 2: Smart-Casual Mix
* **New Item:** 90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * White ribbed tank top
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers
  * Brown leather belt
  * Chunky white sneakers

**Why it works:** 
Pairing the sporty track jacket with tailored wide-leg khaki trousers creates a cool high-low mix of athletic and smart-casual elements. Tucking in the white ribbed tank top and accenting the waist with the brown leather belt adds structure to the outfit, while the chunky white sneakers keep the overall feel grounded and modern.
```

```
Here are two outfits featuring the new 90s track jacket and pieces from the saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear
* **New Item:** 90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * White ribbed tank top
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
  * Chunky white sneakers
  * Black crossbody bag

**Why it works:** 
This look leans directly into the retro streetwear aesthetic of the track jacket. Pairing the lightweight jacket over a fitted white ribbed tank top lets you wear it unzipped or partially zipped for a relaxed vibe. The dark wash baggy jeans complement the 90s silhouette, while the chunky white sneakers tie in the white stripe details on the sleeves. Finished with a minimal black crossbody bag, it’s an effortless, everyday look.

---

### Outfit 2: High-Low Contrast
* **New Item:** 90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers
  * White ribbed tank top
  * Brown leather belt
  * Black combat boots

**Why it works:**
This outfit plays with contrasting styles by mixing the athletic energy of the track jacket with tailored, earth-toned pieces. The wide-leg khaki trousers dressed up with a brown leather belt add structure and a smart-casual element that grounds the sporty top. Layering the jacket over the white tank top keeps the base clean, and finishing the outfit with black combat boots adds an unexpected edge that elevates the whole combination.

Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe** and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear
* **New Item:** 90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * White ribbed tank top
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
  * Chunky white sneakers
  * Black crossbody bag

**Why it works:** 
This look leans directly into the jacket’s athletic, 90s streetwear aesthetic. Layering the track jacket unzipped over the fitted white ribbed tank creates a balanced silhouette against the relaxed fit of the dark wash baggy jeans. Tying it together with chunky white sneakers and a minimal black crossbody bag keeps the vibe effortlessly casual and cohesive.

---

### Outfit 2: High-Low Smart Casual
* **New Item:** 90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers
  * White ribbed tank top
  * Brown leather belt
  * Chunky white sneakers

**Why it works:**
This outfit plays with the contrast between sporty outerwear and tailored separates. Pairing the sporty track jacket with structured wide-leg khaki trousers (pulled together by a classic brown leather belt) creates a cool, high-low hybrid style. Underneath, the white ribbed tank keeps the base simple, while the chunky white sneakers anchor the entire look with a modern streetwear edge.

Here are two outfits featuring the **90s Track Jacket — Navy/White Stripe**:

### Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear

* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * White ribbed tank top
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
  * Chunky white sneakers
  * Black crossbody bag

**Why it works:** 
This look leans into the vintage athletic aesthetic of the track jacket. Pairing the jacket unzipped over the fitted white ribbed tank top creates a balanced silhouette against the relaxed fit of the dark wash baggy jeans. The chunky white sneakers tie the sporty theme together, while the black crossbody bag adds a practical, everyday finish.

---

### Outfit 2: High-Low Contrast

  * White ribbed tank top
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers
  * Brown leather belt

The white ribbed tank top and chunky white sneakers keep the entire ensemble cohesive and effortless.

Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **90s Silk Slip Dress** and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: 90s Grunge Contrast
* **New Item:** 90s Silk Slip Dress — Floral, Midi Length
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt (`w_004`)
  * Black combat boots (`w_008`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
Layering the oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt right over the delicate floral slip dress leans into an authentic 90s indie-sleaze aesthetic. The heavy, rugged texture of the black combat boots creates a great contrast against the soft, fluid silk of the dress, while the black crossbody bag ties the darker accessories together.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Streetwear Layering
* **New Item:** 90s Silk Slip Dress — Floral, Midi Length
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:**
This look bridges feminine and casual streetwear styles. Throwing the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket over the midi-length dress helps ground the floral print and adds a cool, effortless edge. Pairing it with chunky white sneakers keeps the outfit grounded and comfortable for everyday wear.

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **90s Silk Slip Dress** and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: 90s Grunge Contrast
* **New Item:** 90s Silk Slip Dress — Floral, Midi Length
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt (`w_004`)
  * Black combat boots (`w_008`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
Layering the oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt right over the delicate floral midi dress plays into the classic 90s grunge aesthetic—balancing ultra-feminine silhouettes and muted floral prints with heavy, cozy textures. Anchoring the look with the black combat boots and black crossbody bag grounds the lighter ivory and dusty pink tones of the dress while leaning into the vintage vibe.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Streetwear Layer
* **New Item:** 90s Silk Slip Dress — Floral, Midi Length
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:**
This combination takes the dainty, cottagecore elements of the floral slip dress and dresses them down for everyday wear. The slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket hits at just the right spot to complement the midi length, while the chunky white sneakers add a modern, sporty contrast to the vintage floral silk. Finished with the black crossbody bag, it’s an effortless, balanced daytime look.

Here are two outfit ideas featuring the **90s Silk Slip Dress** and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: 90s Grunge Layering
* **New Item:** 90s Silk Slip Dress — Floral, Midi Length
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:** 
  * Oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt (`w_004`)
  * Black combat boots (`w_008`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
Layering the oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt directly over the floral slip dress gives a nod to classic 90s grunge styling. The chunky texture and relaxed fit of the sweatshirt contrast nicely with the delicate, fluid nature of the midi-length silk. Pairing them with black combat boots and the minimalist black crossbody bag grounds the feminine floral print with an edgy, effortless finish.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Vintage Contrast
* **New Item:** 90s Silk Slip Dress — Floral, Midi Length
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:** 
  * Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:**
This combination balances romantic, cottagecore elements with casual streetwear staples. Throwing on the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket adds structure and breaks up the floral print while keeping the color palette cohesive. Finishing the look with chunky white sneakers and the black crossbody bag creates a sporty, everyday juxtaposition against the vintage slip dress.

```
Here are two outfits featuring the **90s Silk Slip Dress** combined with pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: 90s Grunge Contrast
* **New Item:** 90s Silk Slip Dress
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt (`w_004`)
  * Black combat boots (`w_008`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
Layering the oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt right over the delicate floral midi dress plays into quintessential 90s grunge styling, contrasting the soft, feminine print of the slip with heavy, cozy textures. Grounding the look with black combat boots and keeping accessories simple with the black crossbody bag ties the effortless, vintage aesthetic together.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Vintage Layering
* **New Item:** 90s Silk Slip Dress
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
This combination leans into off-duty transitional wear. The slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket hits right around the waist to balance the midi length of the dress. Adding chunky white sneakers gives the outfit a modern, casual twist while keeping the feminine slip dress grounded and wearable for daytime.

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfits built using the new platform sneakers and pieces from the saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Y2K Streetwear Casual
* **New Item:** Platform Sneakers — White Chunky Sole
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
  * Black cropped zip hoodie (`w_005`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why this works:** 
The chunky silhouette and velcro straps of the platform sneakers lean heavily into a late 90s/early 2000s aesthetic. Pairing them with baggy dark-wash jeans creates that authentic, relaxed streetwear proportion. The black cropped zip hoodie balances out the loose fit of the bottoms by defining the waist, while the black crossbody bag ties the dark elements of the look together.

---

### Outfit 2: Effortless Minimal Contrast
* **New Item:** Platform Sneakers — White Chunky Sole
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Vintage black denim jacket (`w_006`)
  * Brown leather belt (`w_009`)

**Why this works:**
This look plays on the contrast between tailored earth tones and sporty footwear. The wide-leg khaki trousers and brown leather belt provide a grounded, minimal base, while the fitted white ribbed tank keeps the top half sleek. Layering the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket adds structure and edge, and the bright white platform sneakers finish the outfit with a casual, modern streetwear twist.
```

Layering the black cropped zip hoodie over the oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt adds dimension and texture up top, while the chunky white platform sneakers finish the outfit with a bold, retro-casual footwear statement that bridges the gap between athletic and relaxed everyday wear.

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfits built using the new platform sneakers and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Y2K Streetwear Casual
* **New Item:** Platform Sneakers — White Chunky Sole
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (w_001)
  * White ribbed tank top (w_003)
  * Vintage black denim jacket (w_006)
  * Black crossbody bag (w_010)

**Why it works:** 
The chunky platform sole and velcro straps of the sneakers lean directly into the late 90s/early 2000s streetwear aesthetic. Pairing them with high-waisted, baggy dark-wash jeans and a fitted white ribbed tank creates a classic proportion play—slim on top, loose on the bottom. Tossing on the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket and adding the black crossbody bag ties the color scheme together while keeping the relaxed, everyday vibe intact.

***

### Outfit 2: Sporty Layered Contrast
* **New Item:** Platform Sneakers — White Chunky Sole
* **Wardrobe Pieces:**
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (w_002)
  * Black cropped zip hoodie (w_005)
  * Brown leather belt (w_009)
  * Black crossbody bag (w_010)

**Why it works:**
This look bridges casual streetwear and elevated minimal style. The sporty black cropped zip hoodie provides a sharp, fitted contrast to the fluid movement of the wide-leg khaki trousers. Pulling the outfit together with a brown leather belt adds a polished anchor, while the white chunky platform sneakers ground the earth tones of the trousers with a bright, retro athletic finish.
```

```
Here are two outfit ideas incorporating the new light wash, cropped denim jacket:

### Outfit 1: Double Denim Streetwear
* **New Item:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** This look plays with proportions and contrast. Pairing the light wash cropped jacket with high-waisted, dark wash baggy jeans creates a distinct two-tone denim effect while accentuating the waist. The fitted white ribbed tank top breaks up the heavy denim, and the chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag lean into an effortless streetwear aesthetic.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Earth Tones
* **New Item:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Brown leather belt (`w_009`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)

**Why it works:** Light-wash denim pairs exceptionally well with warm earth tones like khaki and tan. Tucking the white ribbed tank into the wide-leg khaki trousers (cinched with the brown leather belt) creates a clean, balanced silhouette. Layering the cropped jacket on top adds structure to the relaxed, flowing trousers, while the white sneakers keep the entire outfit grounded and casual.
```

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the new light wash cropped denim jacket and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Double Denim Streetwear
* **New Item:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
This look plays on proportions and contrast. The light wash of the cropped jacket contrasts sharply with the dark indigo of the baggy, high-waisted straight-leg jeans. Layering the fitted white ribbed tank top underneath balances the volume of both the baggy bottoms and the structured shoulders of the jacket. Finished with chunky white sneakers and a black crossbody bag, the outfit leans effortlessly into a classic streetwear aesthetic.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Earth Tones
* **New Item:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Brown leather belt (`w_009`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)

**Why it works:** 
Pairing the light wash denim with wide-leg khaki trousers creates a fresh, warm-weather combination. The fitted white ribbed tank top anchors the outfit, while the brown leather belt adds a refined detail that ties the earthy khaki tones together with casual textures. The cropped length of the jacket highlights the waist above the wide-leg trousers, and chunky white sneakers keep the overall vibe relaxed and modern.
```

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfit options using the new light wash cropped denim jacket and pieces from your wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Double Denim Streetwear Look
* **New Item:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why it works:** 
This look plays on a classic double-denim combination by using high-contrast washes—the light wash of the cropped jacket contrasts sharply against the dark indigo of the baggy straight-leg jeans. Underneath, the fitted white ribbed tank top provides a clean, neutral base that balances the volume of the baggy bottoms and the structured shoulders of the jacket. Finished with chunky white sneakers and a black crossbody bag, the outfit leans effortlessly into a streetwear aesthetic.

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Earth-Tone Contrast
* **New Item:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped
* **Wardrobe Pieces:** 
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Brown leather belt (`w_009`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)

**Why it works:**
Pairing the light blue denim jacket with the wide-leg khaki trousers creates a fresh, balanced mix of cool and warm tones. The cropped length of the jacket helps define the waist against the high-rise, wide-leg cut of the trousers, which can be further accented with the brown leather belt. The white ribbed tank top and chunky white sneakers keep the entire ensemble feeling light, casual, and cohesive.
```

```
Here are two outfit ideas featuring the new light wash cropped denim jacket and pieces from your saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Double Denim Streetwear
* **New Item:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:** 
  * Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash (`w_001`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)
  * Black crossbody bag (`w_010`)

**Why this works:** 
This look plays on the classic Canadian tuxedo by pairing two contrasting denim washes. The cropped length of the light wash jacket sits perfectly against the high-waisted, dark wash baggy jeans, creating a balanced silhouette. Layering the fitted white ribbed tank top underneath adds a clean, bright contrast, while the chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag tie the streetwear aesthetic together effortlessly.

***

### Outfit 2: Casual Earth Tones
* **New Item:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped
* **Wardrobe Pieces Used:** 
  * Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
  * White ribbed tank top (`w_003`)
  * Brown leather belt (`w_009`)
  * Chunky white sneakers (`w_007`)

**Why this works:** 
Light wash denim pairs naturally with warm earth tones. The structured shoulders and cropped cut of the jacket contrast nicely with the relaxed, flowing shape of the wide-leg khaki trousers. Adding the brown leather belt introduces a refined detail that bridges the gap between the casual denim and tailored trousers, and the chunky white sneakers keep the overall vibe grounded and modern.

Here are two outfits built using the new denim jacket and pieces from the saved wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Double Denim Streetwear

The fitted white tank breaks up the denim, while the chunky sneakers and crossbody bag tie the casual streetwear aesthetic together.

### Outfit 2: Casual Contrast Mix
* **Outerwear:** Denim Jacket — Light Wash, Cropped (New Item)
* **Top:** Oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt (`w_004`)
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers (`w_002`)
* **Shoes:** Black combat boots (`w_008`)
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt (`w_009`)

This outfit leans into layering and textural contrast by mixing casual streetwear with earth-toned, minimal pieces. Throwing the cropped light-wash jacket over the oversized grey crewneck adds structure and defines the waist over the slouchy top. The wide-leg khaki trousers anchored by a brown leather belt bring in neutral earth tones, and the black combat boots ground the lighter top half with a tougher finish.
